standard.summary: 分析训练数据中概念/标签之间的几何关系（密度、冲突、层级），用于更智能地采样和加权。
standard.effect: 开启后在训练前生成 concept_geometry.json，训练时按概念密度调整采样概率和 loss 权重。
standard.whenToUse: 数据集中有多个概念/角色/风格，且各概念样本量不均衡时强烈推荐。
standard.avoidWhen: 单角色/单概念的简单数据集不需要；会略增加训练前的预处理时间。

standard_en.summary: Analyses the geometric relationships between concepts and tags in the training data (density, conflict, hierarchy) to sample and weight more intelligently.
standard_en.effect: Once on, concept_geometry.json is generated before training, and during the run sampling probability and loss weight are adjusted by concept density.
standard_en.whenToUse: Strongly recommended when the dataset holds several concepts, characters or styles with unequal sample counts.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Not needed for a simple single-character or single-concept dataset; it does add a little pre-processing time before the run.

advanced.principle: 将每个样本的 caption/tag 解析为概念空间中的点，计算概念密度、共现矩阵和冲突检测。高密度概念被降权采样（curriculum），低密度概念被提升，实现训练均衡。
advanced.intervention: 替换默认的随机采样器为概念感知的 WeightedBatchSampler。
advanced.expectedImpact: 显著改善多概念训练中的概念均衡性；减少高频概念过拟合和低频概念欠拟合。
advanced.tradeoffs: concept_geometry_loss_weighting 进一步在 loss 层面加权，但可能导致低频概念过学；需要短测确认。

advanced_en.principle: Parses each sample's caption/tags into points in concept space, computing concept density, co-occurrence matrices, and conflict detection. High-density concepts are down-weighted in sampling (curriculum) and low-density ones promoted, balancing training.
advanced_en.intervention: Replaces the default random sampler with the concept-aware WeightedBatchSampler.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Markedly improves concept balance in multi-concept training; reduces overfitting on frequent concepts and underfitting on rare ones.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: concept_geometry_loss_weighting further weights at the loss level but can over-learn rare concepts; short-test to confirm.
